metadata.description: The  most  distinctive  features  of  the  Gond  tribal religion are the  cult  of  the  supreme  God Bara  Deo  and  Goddess  khair Maior  the  clan  deities like many other tribes.The religious thinking of the Gonds is saturated with animistic ideas. The Gonds considers the  animate  objects  such  as,  trees,  plants,  animals  as  well  as  human  beings  as  the  abode  of spirits. For them the mystery of natural phenomena can be explained with reference to the spirit of world. The day to  day happening of the human life are attributed  to the spiritual forces
